notes: Unanswerable questions were drawn from traditions verified absent from the corpus (Arthurian, Mesopotamian, Mesoamerican, Japanese/Shinto). Norse and Egyptian mythology, named as example "outside" traditions in the spec, are in fact covered by this corpus (lore_chunks/138-144, 146-156 Hindu/Norse; 116-117 Egyptian) and were excluded from candidate traditions on that basis. Absence for all 8 unanswerable questions was verified two ways: grep across lore_chunks/*.md, and a live query against the built dense index (k=5) confirming no returned passage answers the question, recorded per-question in notes. The paraphrase review pass (checking in-corpus questions do not lexically copy their source) is drafted with containment scores computed but the human sitting to accept/edit flagged questions has not yet happened; see the PR for the pending review table.
